rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken pattern for persuading someone not to do something.

example.english: I tried to discourage him from going on the trip.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hyun3 keoi5 m4 hou2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4

rows.jyutping: daa2 siu1 A ge3 nim6 tau4
rows.note: Use this when talking someone out of an intention or plan they are considering.

rows.jyutping: daa2 gik1 A ge3 seon3 sam1
rows.note: Use this when something undermines a person's confidence or morale.
